q: Why is electricity most of a Penang semiconductor assembly plant's footprint, and how is it reported?
title: Penang chip assembly: Scope 2
short: Back end assembly and test run clean rooms, chillers, compressed air and testers around the clock, so grid electricity usually dwarfs fuel. Report location based Scope 2 with Peninsular Malaysia's grid factor and market based with any green tariff or certificates you hold, then split per unit for customers.
audience: Semiconductor assembly, test and packaging plants and their suppliers in Bayan Lepas, Batu Kawan and Kulim

ul: Clean room air handling and chillers.
Wire bonding, moulding and plating lines.

p: Location based: grid kWh x the Peninsular factor. Market based: subtract kWh covered by a green tariff or retired certificates in your name, at zero.
Customers ask per device or per wafer equivalent. Split by test hours or line hours, not just units, when packages differ.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills into a dated, fingerprinted record per plant; for sites outside India the grid factor is entered from the official source and labelled.
